notes.title: Update: Fixed Invisible Boss Bug!
notes.notes: Update: Fixed Invisible Boss Bug! Quick update! We squashed a bug where the Slime King, Gun Flower, and Bee Hive could sometimes become invisible, making them impossible to hit with melee attacks. They should now stay visible and fightable! Restart the game if the update doesn't apply automatically. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Pixel Dungeon v2.30 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
# 📢 Pixel Dungeon v2.30 Update is Live!
Hey adventurers!
We’ve just rolled out v2.30 with a couple of quality-of-life improvements — especially for content creators and dungeon masters alike:
🆕 **LIV Camera Integration**
We’ve added LIV camera support to help more creators easily record in-game footage content. Allowing selfie, FPOV, and 3rd person view. Capture your dungeon runs in style and bring your content to life with enhanced visuals!
🗺️ **Quest Completion Platform Upgrade**
The end-game summary platform now shows the map name and difficulty level you conquered. Share your achievements with the full glory of context!
As always, thanks for your support and keep those dungeon runs coming. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, drop us a message here!
Happy crawling!

notes.title: Pixel Dungeon VR Full version Release Date
notes.notes:
Pixel Dungeon VR: Official Launch Announcement
Release Date: May 27, 2025 | 07:11 UTC

Dive into the ultimate VR dungeon-crawling experience! Pixel Dungeon VR has officially launched on Steam, bringing brutal challenges, heart-pounding combat, and a world teeming with secrets.

What’s Inside?
4 Unique Maps — Explore cursed crypts, lava-forged labyrinths, and more.
6 Ruthless Difficulty Levels — From “Casual Explorer” to “Souls-Like Survivor,” find your fit (or doom).
Epic Boss Battles — Our latest update introduces bone-crushing boss fights with dynamic mechanics. Dodge fireballs, shatter armor, or become a puddle of regret. Your choice!

About the Last Update: 
🗺New Fourth Map: Explore fresh scenes, encounter new traps, face a variety of new monsters, and prepare for an epic final Boss! The difficulty has been significantly ramped up for seasoned players.
📈Level Cap Increased to 50: Unlock 4 brand-new talents to enhance your gameplay and strategies.
⚔Boss Weapon System Added: Collect fragments from treasure chests to craft 5 unique Boss weapons, or get lucky with rare drops from Boss chests!
🛡Giant Shield Weapons: Equip these massive shields on your back and block incoming damage like never before.
✨Exclusive Attributes: New special attributes tailored for Boss weapons and giant shields, adding more depth to your builds.
📚Weapon Compendium: Check out all weapon stats and how to obtain them in the new weapon encyclopedia.
👥Team Info Page: Find detailed team information easily in the new settings menu.
🏆Achievements for the Fourth Map: Complete new challenges and earn rewards specific to the latest map.
🏅3 New Trophy Quests: Including a special trophy quest featuring Alfred - can you unlock them all?
⭐4 New Completion Ratings: See how well you did with fresh end-of-level evaluations.
Jump in now and experience all the new thrills! We can’t wait to see how you tackle these new challenges. Have fun, stay sharp, and as always, thank you for playing!

Join the Adventure!
🔥 Wishlist & Ready to Play: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063750/Pixel_Dungeon_VR_Multiplayer_RPG/

🎉 Team Up on Discord: Join 20,000+ adventurers strategizing, sharing loot, and screaming about mimics: https://discord.gg/pdvr

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 25/2/14
notes.notes:
🆕 Pixel Dungeon Update
 🎮Feature Updates:
1. Added melee swing damage for shields. Similar to other melee weapons, the damage depends on the swing speed.
2. Added melee damage for the longbow, crossbow, throwing darts, and staff, with a fixed damage of 1 point.
3. Optimized the scaling effect for hit effects of the above-mentioned weapons.
 Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where player levels in the multiplayer lobby were sometimes displayed incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where the controller vibration for the staff didn’t cancel after the player died.
- Fixed an issue where some settings in the settings menu weren’t saved correctly.
- Fixed an issue where some floating UI characters were missing.
- Fixed an issue where the Fallen Angel Boss's position was incorrect when entering the second phase.
- Fixed an issue where the meteor/harpoon animation summoned by the Fallen Angel Boss behaved abnormally.
- Fixed an issue where the Skeleton King Boss got stuck in an invincible state and didn’t move, or remained invincible.

Join our discord for more: https://discord.gg/pdvr

notes.title: 🚨Multiplayer Update for Pixel Dungeon Demo! 🚨
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce a significant update for Pixel Dungeon Demo, and we can’t wait for you to experience the latest additions! As a thank you for your support, we’re introducing several exciting features to enhance your gameplay experience.


🎮 What’s New in Pixel Dungeon Demo:
Level Cap and Content Overview:
The Prologue currently mirrors the content available in the Demo version on our Pixel Dungeon page. In the Demo, players are limited to level 10 for progression. However, this limitation doesn’t hold you back from enjoying all of the exciting content:


Dozens of Monsters and Elite Boss Fights: Prepare to battle a variety of unique monsters and elite bosses, each with their own distinctive attack patterns and strategies. These encounters require tactical thinking and mastery of the game’s mechanics to overcome.


Puzzle-filled Maps: Each dungeon is filled with secrets and hidden areas that challenge your wit and intelligence. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden paths, and discover the lore behind the monsters and dungeons.


Weapon and Upgrade Systems: Collect and use a variety of weapons, each with its own properties and upgrade options. Upgrade your gear to become stronger, defeat tougher enemies, and gain access to new abilities.


Two Intense Boss Fights: Fight your way through two unique boss battles, each designed with intricate combat mechanics. The deeper you dive into the game, the more complex the strategies you’ll need to employ to overcome these foes.


Exclusive Christmas Event: Celebrate the holiday season with special Christmas-themed skins. These festive skins are limited-time only and add a unique visual flair to your gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184253/690fc9f736708a0020f62aecb4930e4df28b8d18.jpg

🎄 How to Join the Fun:

1. Experience Free Multiplayer Gameplay: Join our Discord community to receive an exclusive code to unlock multiplayer mode in the Prologue. Play with your friends and tackle dungeons together!

2. Unlock Exclusive Avatars and Skins: Participate in special in-game tasks to earn Christmas-themed avatars and skins. These limited-time rewards are available only during the holiday event!

3. Team Up with Others: Explore dungeons together in multiplayer mode and enjoy the game with your friends.
